rationale: GSC shows meaningful demand for German non-brand scalp-shampoo queries but weak performance: “shampoo für sensible kopfhaut” has 61 impressions, 0% CTR, and very low average position (~58.3) landing on the product page (https://www.eliraliving.com/de/products/sensitive-scalp-shampoo.html), indicating a mismatch between query intent (guidance/comparison) and current result (product). Creating a dedicated informational article fills a clear content gap without rewriting existing posts: current haircare articles focus on sensitive/itchy scalp care, sulfates, hard-water irritation, and wash frequency—none directly answer the ‘which shampoo / what to look for’ shopping-intent query in German. The new article can internally link to the Sensitive Scalp Shampoo product and to relevant existing supporting articles (sulfates, hard water, itchy scalp) without cannibalizing them by targeting a distinct mid-funnel selection intent.
